patches.summary: Keep active-apis.json aligned with ProApi active services that have CLI support.
patches.reason: ProApi marks 35 services active. The manifest should surface all active APIs in datpaq api, datpaq sample, and splash.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli -run TestSupportedWebsiteActiveAPIsAreActive passes; go run ./cmd/datpaq api --agent lists 35 interfaces.

patches.summary: Add hand-authored CLI and MCP support for active phone-validation and web-scraping services.
patches.reason: These services are active in ProApi but absent from the generated CLI spec, so manifest changes alone could not expose working commands.
patches.validated_outcome: Focused tests assert request path/body construction for phone-validation and web-scraping; go test ./... passes.

patches.summary: Route the DNS CLI and MCP tool through the production /dns-lookup gateway path.
patches.reason: The independent review reproduced production 404s on /dns while /dns-lookup succeeds; CLI and MCP should call the working gateway route.
patches.validated_outcome: Focused DNS CLI test asserts GET /dns-lookup with domain/type query parameters and clean agent output.

patches.summary: Suppress generated mutation partial-failure warnings in machine-readable output modes.
patches.reason: Agent, JSON, compact, quiet, plain, selected-field, and piped output must remain deterministic and should not be polluted by stderr warnings unless the user is in a human-facing table mode.
patches.validated_outcome: Focused generated-mutation test asserts --agent keeps stdout valid JSON and stderr warning-free while preserving structured partial_failure data.

patches.summary: Normalize generated command separators when ranking datpaq which queries.
patches.reason: Natural queries like "mx lookup" should rank the hyphenated mx-lookup commands above unrelated commands that only share the generic word lookup.
patches.validated_outcome: which ranking test asserts "mx lookup" resolves to the mx-lookup group first.

patches.summary: Render REST samples with API wire parameter names instead of CLI flag names for commands whose names differ.
patches.reason: Convert Time samples used source-time/source-zone/target-zone in URLs even though the runtime request and API expect sourceTime/sourceZone/targetZone; touched APIs with known flag-to-wire differences get explicit mappings.
patches.validated_outcome: Sample tests assert Convert Time, Web Scraping, and MX Lookup snippets use API wire query/body names.

patches.summary: Route MX lookup commands through /mx-lookup and send the plural domains parameter.
patches.reason: The live gateway exposes /api/v1/mx-lookup and expects domains; generated GET and batch code used stale domain and nested path shapes.
patches.validated_outcome: Focused MX CLI tests assert GET query mapping, batch POST body/path, and clean agent output.

patches.summary: Add hand-authored CLI and MCP support for weather, calendar, geocoding, qr-code, pdf-generation, and web-search.
patches.reason: These ProApi services have website landing pages and public /api/v1 routes but were absent from the generated CLI spec.
patches.validated_outcome: Focused request-construction tests for the six APIs; go test ./internal/cli ./internal/mcp passes.

patches.summary: Extract shared POST/stdin helpers for hand-authored APIs; fix geocoding dry-run; expand MCP parameter parity; default PDF responseType to base64.
patches.reason: Code-structure review found duplicated stdin/POST blocks across six new services; high code review found a dry-run failure and incomplete MCP bindings before production.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli ./internal/mcp passes; geocoding batch --dry-run succeeds; sample qr-code generate no longer emits stdin; dry-run shapes match ProAPI wire names for all 15 endpoints.

patches.summary: Add private pre-Cobra /gummie toggle between production and staging API base URLs.
patches.reason: Need a hidden staging/production switch that must never appear in --help, agent-context, MCP, README, or regenerated docs.
patches.validated_outcome: Focused gummie tests pass; /gummie absent from --help and agent-context command list.

patches.summary: Sync CLI OpenAPI/active-apis to website's 35 APIs; fix gateway paths for define, states, and sample-data shortcuts.
patches.reason: Website API_ACTIVE_SLUGS and openapi.yaml list 35 live APIs. The CLI still advertised 41 and its spec.yaml omitted several active services while retaining deactivated ones in discovery.
patches.validated_outcome: Path-route tests cover /dictionary, /us-states, /sample-data/{generate,generate-batch,schemas}; go test ./internal/cli ./internal/mcp passes; datpaq api --agent lists 35.

patches.summary: Rename CLI/MCP interface from states to us-states to match ProAPI /api/v1/us-states.
patches.reason: The service slug and gateway path are us-states; discovery and command names should match. Legacy `states` remains a cobra alias.
patches.validated_outcome: datpaq api --agent lists us-states; datpaq states list alias still works; gateway path tests pass.

patches.summary: Finish states→us-states sync for docs and local cache resource type.
patches.reason: Command/MCP already used us-states; SKILL.md and resolveRead/store generic resource_type still said states.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli ./internal/store ./internal/mcp passes; SKILL.md documents us-states.

patches.summary: Move the CLI code exchange default from the ProAPI gateway namespace to Mainsite's internal API namespace.
patches.reason: Nginx routes /api/v1 to ProAPI and requires an API key there, so browser login must exchange its one-time authorization code directly with Mainsite.
patches.validated_outcome: Focused auth login test asserts the production exchange URL is https://datpaq.com/api/internal/cli/auth/exchange.

patches.summary: Restyle the localhost browser callback as a minimal Datpaq success page.
patches.reason: The generated purple terminal card did not match the website; CLI authentication should use Datpaq's white canvas, top-left DP. wordmark, typography, green success treatment, and simple copyright footer.
patches.validated_outcome: Focused auth tests assert the top-left wordmark, green success icon, copyright footer, and removal of the retired purple and animated-footer styling.

patches.summary: Re-activate web-search and deactivate exchange-rates-and-currency to match the staging.datpaq.com 63-API catalog; sync spec.yaml.
patches.reason: Staging /api-list (63 APIs, shipping to production week of 2026-10-12) includes web-search and omits exchange-rates-and-currency. Deactivated commands stay callable.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli ./internal/mcp passes; datpaq api --agent lists 35 interfaces including web-search, excluding exchange-rates-and-currency.

patches.summary: Add a declarative endpoint table that builds CLI commands, which entries, and sample wire names from one definition; first consumer is interest-rate.
patches.reason: 28 staging-catalog APIs (~100 endpoints) are absent from the generated spec; one table avoids repeating flag/request boilerplate per endpoint.
patches.validated_outcome: Table-driven tests assert method, path, and wire params for every declared endpoint plus required-flag enforcement; go test ./... passes.

patches.summary: Register typed MCP tools and a spec.yaml parity test for table-declared APIs; add libor and mortgage-calculator.
patches.reason: MCP params and the published OpenAPI must match CLI wiring for every declared endpoint; libor and mortgage-calculator are in the staging 63-API catalog.
patches.validated_outcome: MCP test asserts each declared endpoint has a tool with all params; spec parity test covers every declared operation and wire param; go test ./... passes.

patches.summary: Add market-cap, sec-filings, gdp, economic-indicators, and unemployment via the declared endpoint table.
patches.reason: These services are in the staging 63-API catalog; unemployment metro routes are omitted because ProApi hard-codes 503 for them.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./... passes: table-driven request, required-flag, MCP-param, and spec.yaml parity tests cover every new endpoint.

patches.summary: Add iban, vat-validation-and-rates, and income-tax via the declared endpoint table.
patches.reason: These services are in the staging 63-API catalog. GET/POST twins on one route use the existing -get suffix convention for the GET command.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./... passes: table-driven request, required-flag, MCP-param, and spec.yaml parity tests cover every new endpoint.

patches.summary: Add lorem-ipsum, translate, deslop, diffy, color-convert, encoding-convert, data-format-convert, and markdown-convert via the declared endpoint table.
patches.reason: These services are in the staging 63-API catalog. Pure alias routes (GET /lorem-ipsum, POST /color-convert) are not exposed separately.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./... passes: table-driven request, required-flag, MCP-param, and spec.yaml parity tests cover every new endpoint.

patches.summary: Add document-convert, document-generation, pdf-toolkit, and ocr; add file/files param types that base64-encode local files.
patches.reason: These services are in the staging 63-API catalog and take base64 file content, which users cannot reasonably paste on the command line.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./... passes: table-driven request, required-flag, MCP-param, and spec.yaml parity tests cover every new endpoint.

patches.summary: Add breach-check, tech-stack-detection, logo, structured-extraction, and ping-human via the declared endpoint table, completing the 63-API staging catalog.
patches.reason: These services are in the staging 63-API catalog. breach-check exposes only the hash-prefix password check; ping-human reply routes are human-facing and not gateway APIs.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./... passes: table-driven request, required-flag, MCP-param, and spec.yaml parity tests cover every new endpoint.

patches.summary: Add docs/adding-apis.md and scripts/api-sync tooling for table-declared APIs; pass path args in the required-flag test.
patches.reason: 40+ more ProApi services are coming; the runbook and finisher script make adding them repeatable, and a throwaway-API dry run exposed the test gap for path+required-flag endpoints.
patches.validated_outcome: Throwaway API with a path param and required flag passes add-api.sh end to end; go test ./... passes.
